ADD register.description: ADD DR, SR1, SR2. Add two registers; store in DR. Updates condition codes.

ADD immediate.description: ADD DR, SR1, imm5. Add SR1 and a signed immediate from -16 to 15; store in DR. Updates condition codes.

AND register.description: AND DR, SR1, SR2. Bitwise AND two registers; store in DR. Updates condition codes.

AND immediate.description: AND DR, SR1, imm5. Bitwise AND SR1 and a signed immediate from -16 to 15; store in DR. Updates condition codes.

NOT.description: NOT DR, SR. Bitwise complement of SR into DR; updates condition codes.

LD.description: LD DR, LABEL. Load memory at label into DR. Label must be within -256 to 255 words of the next instruction.

LDI.description: LDI DR, LABEL. Load through the address stored at label into DR. Label must be within -256 to 255 words of the next instruction.

LEA.description: LEA DR, LABEL. Load the address of label into DR. Label must be within -256 to 255 words of the next instruction.

ST.description: ST SR, LABEL. Store SR at label. PC-relative offset is -256 to 255.

STI.description: STI SR, LABEL. Store SR through the address at label. PC-relative offset is -256 to 255.

LDR.description: LDR DR, BaseR, offset6. Load into DR at BaseR + offset6. Offset range: -32 to 31.

STR.description: STR SR, BaseR, offset6. Store SR at BaseR + offset6. Offset range: -32 to 31.

BR.description: Branch to LABEL when any condition code is set. PC-relative range: -256 to 255 words.

BRn.description: Branch to LABEL when negative. PC-relative range: -256 to 255 words.

BRz.description: Branch to LABEL when zero. PC-relative range: -256 to 255 words.

BRp.description: Branch to LABEL when positive. PC-relative range: -256 to 255 words.

BRnz.description: Branch to LABEL when negative or zero. PC-relative range: -256 to 255 words.

BRnp.description: Branch to LABEL when negative or positive. PC-relative range: -256 to 255 words.

BRzp.description: Branch to LABEL when zero or positive. PC-relative range: -256 to 255 words.

BRnzp.description: Branch to LABEL when any condition code is set. PC-relative range: -256 to 255 words.

JMP.description: JMP BaseR. Jump to the address in BaseR.

JSR.description: JSR LABEL. Save return address in R7 and call LABEL, within -1024 to 1023 words.

JSRR.description: JSRR BaseR. Save return address in R7 and call address in BaseR.

RET.description: RET No operands. Return to address in R7.

RTI.description: RTI No operands. Return from interrupt, privileged instruction.

TRAP.description: TRAP trapvect8. Invoke an 8-bit trap vector, x00 to xFF; saves return address in R7.

GETC.description: GETC No operands. Read a character into R0 without echo.

OUT.description: OUT No operands. Print the character in R0.

PUTS.description: PUTS No operands. Print the null-terminated string whose address is in R0.

IN.description: IN No operands. Prompt for a character, echo it and store it in R0.

PUTSP.description: PUTSP No operands. Print packed characters from the address in R0.

HALT.description: HALT No operands. Stop the program.

CHAT.description: CHAT No operands. Minecraft chat: R0 holds the address of a null-terminated string.

GETP.description: GETP No operands. Read player position into R0=x, R1=y, R2=z.

SETP.description: SETP No operands. Move player to R0=x, R1=y, R2=z.

GETB.description: GETB No operands. Read block at R0=x, R1=y, R2=z; return block ID in R3.

SETB.description: SETB No operands. Set block at R0=x, R1=y, R2=z to block ID in R3.

GETH.description: GETH No operands. Read highest block height at R0=x, R2=z; return y in R1.

REG.description: REG No operands. Print register values to the terminal.

.ORIG.description: .ORIG address. Set the program starting address.

.FILL.description: .FILL value. Allocate one word initialized to value.

.BLKW.description: .BLKW count. Reserve count words of memory.

.STRINGZ.description: .STRINGZ "text". Store a string followed by a zero word.
